title: Design System: 作业小管家 Homework Tracker

display.purpose: Page titles, reader article titles, login brand name.

title.purpose: Section headers, card titles, dialog titles.

label.purpose: Nav items, button text, form labels.

reading-zh.purpose: Chinese article body. LXGW WenKai for warmth.

reading-en.purpose: English article body. Fraunces for editorial feel.

shadows.name: elevation-raised
shadows.purpose: Button default, card default. Barely-visible tactile cue.

shadows.name: elevation-floating
shadows.purpose: Dropdowns, popovers, hover-lift animation end state.

shadows.name: elevation-modal
shadows.purpose: Modals, drawers. Large offset + blur = strong top-layer signal.

shadows.name: parchment
shadows.purpose: Reader cards. Inner shadow for paper thickness, outer for book-open feel.

motion.name: ease-out-custom
motion.purpose: Default easing for button hover, card lift, state transitions.

motion.name: ease-in-out-custom
motion.purpose: Page-turn animation, page curl, large layout transitions.

motion.name: bounce
motion.purpose: Stamp-reveal only. Physical overshoot for the stamp-down feel.

motion.name: duration-ritual
motion.purpose: Page turn, level-up reveal. Ritual moments.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.purpose: Switch between sidebar nav and top nav in parent shell.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call-to-action. Forest green background, white text. Used for primary actions per screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: 'Inter', 'Source Han Sans SC', 'PingFang SC', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.5; background: #56AB91; color: #FFFFFF; padding: 12px 20px; border: none; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(10,27,20,0.04); transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #3D8B76; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(10,27,20,0.08), 0 0 0 1px rgba(232,234,237,0.5); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; transform: none; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Secondary action. Subtle forest green surface, darker green text.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: 'Inter', 'Source Han Sans SC', 'PingFang SC', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.5; background: #E5F0E8; color: #2D6B5A; padding: 12px 20px; border: none; border-radius: 12px; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #CADFD0; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Accent Button
components.description: High-emphasis destructive or attention actions. Coral background. Max 1 per screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-accent { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: 'Inter', 'Source Han Sans SC', 'PingFang SC', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.5; background: #F26033; color: #FFFFFF; padding: 12px 20px; border: none; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(10,27,20,0.04); transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-accent:hover { background: #D54A1F; } .ds-btn-accent:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Low-emphasis. Table row actions, toolbar icon buttons. Transparent with hover background.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-ghost"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"/><path d="m21 21-4.3-4.3"/></svg> 搜索</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; font-family: 'Inter', 'Source Han Sans SC', 'PingFang SC', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.875rem; background: transparent; color: #5F6368; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 12px; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #F1F3F4; }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.description: Parent shell sidebar navigation item. Active state uses forest green subtle background.
components.html: 总览作业管理
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; padding: 8px 12px; } .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 12px; font-family: 'Inter', 'Source Han Sans SC', 'PingFang SC', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 400; color: #5F6368; text-decoration: none; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: #F8F9FA; color: #202124; } .ds-nav-item-active { background: #F4F9F5; color: #2D6B5A; font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Bottom Nav Tab
components.description: Child shell bottom tab bar item. Active state uses forest green.
components.html: 今日进度
components.css: .ds-bottom-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-around; height: 64px; background: #FFFFFF; border-top: 1px solid #DADCE0; padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px); } .ds-bnav-item { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 2px; min-width: 44px; min-height: 44px; font-family: 'Inter', 'Source Han Sans SC', 'PingFang SC', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 400; color: #80868B; text-decoration: none; transition: color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-bnav-item:hover { color: #5F6368; } .ds-bnav-item-active { color: #56AB91; }

components.name: Achievement Badge
components.description: Reading title badge. Gradient from honey to coral, pill shape, used for reading achievement display.
components.html:
阅读大师
连续7天准确率90%+
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 9999px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FFFAEB, #FFF4F0); border: 1px solid #FFE08A; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(10,27,20,0.04); font-family: 'Inter', 'Source Han Sans SC', 'PingFang SC', system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Passcode Input
components.description: 4-digit passcode entry. Individual cells with filled/active/error states.
components.css: .ds-passcode { display: flex; gap: 12px; } .ds-passcode-cell { width: 56px; height: 56px; text-align: center; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 700; background: #FDFCF8; border: 2px solid #CADFD0; border-radius: 24px; outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms; } .ds-passcode-cell:focus { border-color: #56AB91; } .ds-passcode-filled { border-color: #56AB91; } .ds-passcode-error { border-color: #F26033; }

narrative.northStar: The Growing Notebook — 成长手账
narrative.overview: A companion notebook that grows with the child. Not a school workbook — an open journal on a desk, recording each day's learning. Warm but structured, playful but not noisy. Visual system avoids cartoonish children's aesthetics (ABCmouse) and cold SaaS dashboards equally. Colors extracted from natural objects: forest, honey, coral. The reader is an independent visual world within the notebook.
keyCharacteristics: Paper texture comes from cream-50 warmth and subtle shadow layering, not bitmap textures
Forest green carries navigation + primary actions at 30-40% surface, coral for emphasis, honey for reward moments only
Radius tightened to 8-12px to span G4-G7 age range — G7 kids won't feel talked down to
Reader is an independent visual world: 3 themes, dedicated fonts, immersive fullscreen

rules.name: The Reward-Only Rule
rules.body: Honey gold never appears in navigation, forms, or regular buttons. It is for points, badges, check-in success. Scarcity is the incentive.

rules.name: The One-Green Rule
rules.body: Forest green is the sole system function color. No blue links, no green success states — forest green carries primary + success, coral carries emphasis + danger. Keeps color vocabulary at 3 semantic roles.

rules.name: The Reading Separation Rule
rules.body: Reader body fonts never share with UI. Entering an article switches from Inter to LXGW WenKai / Fraunces — the font switch is the 'now you are reading' signal.

rules.name: The Single Sans Rule
rules.body: Inter is the only sans font in product UI. Inter Tight only for brand titles (Display level). Fraunces only for English reading. No third sans family.

rules.name: The Grounded-By-Default Rule
rules.body: At rest, elements are separated by tonal layering. Shadows are reserved for interaction feedback (hover/focus/active) and intentional overlays (menu/modal/reader-card). 'Shadow = something is happening.'

dos: Use forest green as the sole system function color (nav + actions + success), ≤40% screen area
Reserve honey gold for reward moments only — points, achievements, check-in completion animations
Use tonal layering (cream bottom → white card → forest-subtle selected) for hierarchy; shadows only for floating layers and interaction feedback
Keep radii 8-12px for navigation/buttons/inputs; reader cards can use 18-32px
Use LXGW WenKai / Fraunces for reader body, Inter only for UI. The font switch signals reading mode.
Provide hover + focus-visible + active states for every interactive element; touch targets ≥44pt
Use cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) as default easing; page-turn uses cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1); only stamp-reveal uses bounce easing
donts: Don't use anthropomorphic animal mascots, bouncing emoji, or flat-block children's illustration style (ABCmouse) — G6-G7 kids feel insulted
Don't stack data metrics on the child-facing side (daily minutes, completion rate percentage) — this is a notebook, not a CRM dashboard
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text), glass cards, hero metrics templates, or identical card grids — SaaS cliché prohibited
Don't build dark sidebar + data table 'admin system' — parent side should feel warm too; parents are family members not admin operators
Don't use border-left/right greater than 1px as colored decorative stripes
Don't mix reader fonts (LXGW WenKai / Fraunces) into UI components — font roles are strictly separated
Don't use red/green alone to convey success/failure — always pair with icon or text for color-blind accessibility
Don't use pure black (#000) or pure white (#FFF) — all neutrals are micro-warm-tinted toward forest green hue
